title: Aromatic Smoked Filipino Chicken Bowl
description: A charred, bouncy-qq chicken bowl infused with peach sweetness, smoky undertones, and Filipino flavors, served in a cozy Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Toss the chicken pieces into the hot skillet and sear until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Whisk together peach juice, low-sodium soy sauce, fish sauce, minced garlic, minced ginger, chili flakes, liquid smoke, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Pour the sauce over the chicken, reduce heat to medium, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Transfer the chicken and sauce into a preheated Korean brass bowl to retain warmth and aroma.
Garnish with a sprinkle of fresh sliced chili or a drizzle of peach glaze if desired.
Serve hot, letting the bowl’s warmth infuse the flavors.
Enjoy your aromatic smoked Filipino chicken bowl.
